component.name: Maintainer
component.summary: Monitor, maintain, diagnose, and understand your Linux system

description.p: Maintainer is a modern, lightweight native desktop application for monitoring, maintaining, diagnosing, and understanding Ubuntu-based Linux computers.
It provides one calm place to:

ul.li: Understand CPU, memory, storage, temperature, network, and process activity
Inspect available system, Flatpak, and firmware updates where supported
Diagnose failed services and recurring journal events
Inspect SMART storage health where supported
Generate a useful, privacy-conscious local system report

description.p: Maintainer does not promise fake optimization, automatic duplicate deletion, cloud monitoring, or arbitrary system tweaking. The GUI always runs unprivileged. No permanent daemon. No telemetry.

Development candidate with bounded background work, stable process confirmation, duplicate inspection, settings recovery, and private report export. Package operations retain their reviewed native APT plan; file cleanup uses protected quarantine and recoverable outcomes.
Adds dedicated Network and Processes pages, an optional internet speed test, clearer temperature reporting, more reliable system updates, consistent icons, and refined light and dark themes.

Adds kernel management with safe, triple-protected removal of old kernels, restructures the Overview and System pages with real storage and network visualizations and per-core/per-disk detail, and fixes update discovery to use apt's dist-upgrade resolver so kernel updates are no longer hidden.

Privileged actions now prompt for a password as intended, since the required D-Bus and systemd files were missing from the previous release. Fixes update classification for Linux Mint and Debian security origins, discloses kernel updates and reboot-required state, and adds security-only and per-package update selection that re-plans through apt's dependency resolver.
Ships the full interface, which the 1.0.0 package did not contain, and lowers idle CPU use by refreshing only the visible page.
